body.p: Claims 1-3 were objected to because of informalities.
As indicated above, Applicant has amended claims 1 and 3 to address the identified issues. Withdrawal of the objection to the claims is respectfully requested.

Claims 1-3 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor regards as the invention.
As indicated above, Applicant has amended claim 1 to address the identified issues. Withdrawal of the 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) rejection is respectfully requested.

Finally, claims 1-3 were indicated as allowable if rewritten or amended to overcome the rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) set forth in the office action. Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowable subject matter.
As discussed above, Applicant has amended the claims to overcome the claim rejections and address the claim objections. Thus, claims 1 to 3 should be in condition for allowance.
Applicant therefore respectfully requests that the Examiner indicate all of the claims as allowed and pass the application to allowance.
The amendments to the claims were done merely to expedite prosecution of the present case. Applicant reserves any and all rights to pursue the subject matter of the
original claims in this application, or in another application. Moreover, these amendments should not be construed as an admission or acquiescence to any rejection.

Furthermore, the fact that Applicant has only addressed certain rejections should not be considered to be acquiescence to the rejections. Rather, Applicant has presented the argument herein in an effort to expedite prosecution. Applicant reserves any and all rights to address any rejection made but not specifically addressed herein.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.
Respectfully submitted, GREER, BURNS & CRAIN, LTD.
